motions.label: Programmed back get-up · sensor handoff
motions.description: Three seconds of motor-held settling, then get-up and learned balance. This nominal example passes both timesteps. 10/10 fresh starting poses pass both timesteps; recovery is still experimental.
motions.limit_text: The supervisor can hand over earlier using IMU and hip encoders. On matched settled starts: 10/10 pass both timesteps with this supervisor, 6/10 with the original timer. This is a programmed get-up with a learned balance endpoint. No impacts, hardware variation, self-contact dynamics or all-direction recovery qualification.
